# Repeatable (up to 6 hosts, 5-year cooldown): Charter each of the 6 Cossack Frontier Hosts.
oe_rp2_dec_charter_cossack_host = {
    decision_category = country_specific_decisions
    hide_repeatable_tag = yes
    potential = {
        oe_rus_country = yes
        current_year >= 1490
        oe_rp2_yoke_clear = yes
        OR = {
            NOT = { has_variable = oe_rp2_hosts_chartered }
            AND = { has_variable = oe_rp2_hosts_chartered var:oe_rp2_hosts_chartered < 6 }
        }
    }
    allow = {
        is_subject = no
        gold >= 80
        NOT = { has_variable = oe_rp2_host_cd }
    }
    ai_will_do = { value = 0 }
    illustration_tags = { 10 = armed 10 = exterior }
    illustration_scope = { event_illustration_poptype_effect = { foreground = pop_type:soldiers background = pop_type:peasants } }
    option = {
        name = oe_rp2_dec_charter_cossack_host.a
        effect = {
            add_gold = -80
            set_variable = { name = oe_rp2_host_cd months = 60 }
            oe_rp2_charter_next_host = yes
            add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_rp2_cossack_free_charter years = 20 mode = replace }
            if = {
                limit = { country_exists = c:ZAZ NOT = { tag = ZAZ } }
                c:ZAZ = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_rp2_b_cossack_compact target = root } }
            }
        }
    }
    option = {
        name = oe_rp2_dec_charter_cossack_host.b
        effect = {
            add_gold = -140
            set_variable = { name = oe_rp2_host_cd months = 60 }
            oe_rp2_charter_next_host = yes
            add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_rp2_cossack_crown_hosts years = 20 mode = replace }
        }
    }
}
